ground_truth.title: 7 Healthy Air Fryer Recipes
ground_truth.author: Lillie
ground_truth.main_content:
I’m ALWAYS getting asked if having an air fryer is worth it. Is it worth storing? Pulling out? Cleaning? Well, after having one and using it repeatedly, I can confidently say that an air fryer is DEFINITELY worth having! It’s a major time-saver and the food comes out tasting amazing. Whether you’re new to air frying or you’ve been doing it for years, I’ve got some quick and healthy air fryer recipes that you’re going to LOVE!

Healthy Air Fryer Recipes

These air fryer recipes make it easy to eat healthier at home! The air fryer crisps up the food without drenching it in oil. You can air fry chicken, fish, veggies, and more! I use these recipes to make quick snacks for myself and large healthy meals for my family.

Cilantro Lime Air Fryer Chicken Tenderloins

These cilantro lime air fryer chicken tenderloins are super easy to make and ready in a flash. They're packed with flavor and are a great protein to add to your weekly rotation.

Hot Honey Air Fryer Salmon Bites

I'm obsessed with these air fryer salmon bites! It's an easy salmon recipe that produces perfectly tender, bite-sized pieces of salmon to add to your bowls for a quick lunch on busy days!

Air Fryer Snap Peas

You'll love these easy and delicious, macro-friendly air fried snap peas!

Air Fryer Blackened Mahi Mahi

Take your Mahi Mahi game to the next level with this air fryer Mahi Mahi. The blackened seasoning adds the best flavor, and it's perfect in bowls and salads!

10-Minute Air Fryer Asparagus with Parmesan

You'll love how easy it is to cook this air fryer asparagus! In less than 10 minutes, you'll have a beautiful and delicious side!

Greek Pork Taquitos in the Air Fryer

Greek food. I can’t get enough! These taquitos have all my favorite Greek flavors wrapped up in a crunchy corn tortilla.

Easy Air Fried Fish Tacos

Give these easy air fryer fish tacos a chance, and they just might make it onto your weekly rotation. They're seriously so good and so easy!

Air Fryer Recipes

These healthy air fryer recipes are great for healthy homemade meals and snacks! Not only are they delicious, but they’re macro-friendly too making it easier to cook for your family and stay on track.

If you’re looking for more macro-friendly meals then make sure to grab my dinner meal plan or one of my macro-friendly cookbooks. All of my recipes are macro-friendly and loaded into MyFitnessPal, Lose It, and Macros First for easy tracking!
